mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_candidates ( meeting_id, proposer_participant_id, place_name, address, latitude, longitude, is_active ) VALUES ( #{meetingId}, #{proposerParticipantId}, #{placeName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, TRUE )
mapper.select:
SELECT candidate_id, meeting_id, proposer_participant_id, place_name, address, latitude, longitude, is_active, created_at, updated_at
FROM meeting_candidates
WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY candidate_id
